# XHelpers Pro 1.0.10 (21)
- Import and update public YouTube playlists without signing in to Google or supplying developer credentials. Public details use the publisher's service after a separate privacy disclosure. - YouTube account connection, account playlists and Liked Videos are not available in this version. Existing account imports and saved access remain on this Mac, but account items cannot be refreshed or played. You can remove saved access locally and manage Google's authorization in Google Account permissions. - Public imports show short service cooldowns and can be cancelled. Saved playlist structure survives temporary service failures and the account feature's unavailability; cached API information still expires. - Open native Apple Music playlists from the shared sidebar. Preserve pinned playlists and recent entries across refreshes and account reconnects. - Improve recognition of supported, unprotected files in your Music library for playback with the local player, including its duration, seek, and volume controls. Keep seek requests made while a track is preparing. - Seek precisely by clicking or dragging the timeline. Cancel a pending seek when the queue changes to a different item. - Improve sidebar resizing, display resolved song metadata in the queue, and highlight the current queue item throughout playback. - Keep video geometry stable when expanding or collapsing the player, preserve chosen window and queue sizes, and refine the shared volume controls. - Mark cleanup tools as early previews and show a persistent notice in their dialogs.
YouTube's visible player, video availability and playback restrictions still apply. Protected or streaming Apple Music items continue to use MusicKit; per-player volume adjustment is unavailable for those items.
